Tess (CSM): FYI AuroraFinance hit a sudden ~52% drop in nightly invoice generation volume since Wed. Procurement (new lead: Aaron) is running a side-by-side with CompetitorQ. Renewal in ~8 weeks. Need a quick ribbit triage so AM can prep a retention offer. :frog:
Milo (AM): When's their shortlist/decision window?
Tess (CSM): They said shortlist by next Thu. Pivot seems price-first; PM called out per-invoice cost and deterministic throughput for batch jobs. Dashboard snapshot: https://redwood.dash/aurora/invoices
```
Nightly jobs: 10.2k -> 4.9k
Avg tokens/job: 21.6k -> 19.8k
Top cost route: /invoice-gen (74%)
Active seats steady: 55
```
Rasheed (Solutions Eng): Any latency or error spikes? Could be a client-side throttling change.
Tess (CSM): No latency or error signal. Their QA also ran a formatting check and found a low-frequency template edge-case (2 malformed invoices) that procurement flagged as a risk, but price is driving shortlist. Aaron asked about a cheaper model alternative.
Lina (RevOps): I can run an immediate cost comparison: baseline hosted vs optimized reserved slots + batching + int8 quant vs CompetitorQ quote. If we can show ~20% TCO improvement with config + a 2-week reserved pilot, we might keep them. I have an initial table in 90 mins.
Milo (AM): Rasheed 8 can you sketch the config changes (batch window, KV prefix cache, quant profile) and expected token/GPU cost delta, plus any quality caveats? 15-min deck for procurement.
Rasheed (Solutions Eng): Sure. Plan: enable prefix cache for invoice templates, bump batch window to 10s for nightly jobs, enable int8 quant for the gen model and add post-gen template validator + auto-rerank. Expected: ~22% unit cost drop, <5% median latency increase for nightly jobs, small risk to strict formatting edge-cases (caught by validator). ETA 2pm PT.
infra-bot: [action] reserved-pool aurora-pilot-2024-08-20 provisioned by rasheed at 2024-08-20T16:08:11Z
Tess (CSM): I'll ask Aaron for the malformed invoice sample + exact PQ acceptance thresholds, and schedule a 30m canary sync.
Lina (RevOps): Quick draft numbers: baseline $0.038/token -> optimized $0.030/token (~21% delta). CompetitorQ quoted $0.025/token but excludes prefix caching and streaming; also note their SLA/observability is limited. Posting CSV to Drive.
Milo (AM): Good. Action owners:
- Rasheed: config list + before/after cost and perf snapshot (2pm PT)
- Lina: contract excerpt + clean cost comparison (2pm PT)
- Tess: collect repro + schedule canary sync with Aaron (EOD)
- Milo: draft short pilot offer (2-week reserved pool + observability + 10% credit) and exec note (by TOM)
Any objections?
Rasheed (Solutions Eng): No objections. I'll also include a quick rollback plan and note the rerank thresholding for formatting errors.
Tess (CSM): If cost delta looks good, can we include a pro-rated discount for month 1 and a fast SLA addendum for the pilot? Milo, can you own discount approval?
Milo (AM): Yes, will propose a pro-rated 12% first-month credit and quick SLA addendum. Legal ping once Lina posts contract excerpt.
Tess (CSM): Thanks team. I'll update here after Rasheed posts the canary snapshot. :+1:
